# Known upstream failures: a matching failed test is a warning (yellow), not an error.
# One entry per line: <fnmatch pattern on the pytest node id> | <reason> | <upstream issue URL or "not filed">
# fnmatch reads "[" as a character class, so "?" stands in for the "[" before parameters.
# List a failure here only once it is classified as an upstream issue, never for a setup bug of ours.

# The tests set BNB_CUDA_VERSION but do not patch torch.version.hip; on ROCm torch the rocm prefix and BNB_ROCM_VERSION apply.

tests/test_cuda_setup_evaluator.py::test_override_invalid_format | test assumes CUDA torch (does not patch torch.version.hip) | not filed

# float32 thresholds measured on an RTX 4090; ROCm exceeds them by a few float32 roundings on long inner reductions.
